reference.observation: Ambient typography and explicit host direction align Native ConfigProvider. Search prefix, Input prefix and global Button/private variable namespaces are independent. Native keeps value, IME, refs, reset, disabled-loading Button and form contracts. Loading sample explicitly disables both public Source controls; loading-only disabled Button remains a separate existing Native contract. Source Compact fallback key includes the global prefix, remounting Input on a shared prefix change. Raw transition identities/focus are retained; expectedNative styles are measured after public Search ref focus and selection restoration. Native retains its existing stable nodes, focus and selection. Source enterButton=true produces an empty Button content node and padded width; iconOnly measures public enterButton with a primary icon-only Button. Source shared local class caches the first global private height namespace; freshNested measures an independent fresh local class in the Inner provider. Raw result and narrow matched counterparts remain separate.
